Commerce Dashboard is a whole store admin for the Halden home goods shop, made from the other commerce blocks. Home and Analytics are Sales Overview, Orders is Orders Table, an order opens in Order Detail with the Refund sheet, Products opens Product Editor, Inventory is Inventory Table, and Discounts opens Discount Builder. The dashboard adds only the glue: a sidebar, a top bar with search and notifications, routing, one shared store, and small Products, Customers and Discounts lists.

Routing lives in the block. Pages are hash URLs like #/orders/order-1042, so Back and Forward work and links open in a new tab, and you can swap in Next.js routes through the router prop. Leaving a page with unsaved product, stock or discount edits is blocked with a message, including with the browser’s Back button. Pages cross-fade in 150 ms, and not at all with reduced motion.
Sales channels and which are shown. { id, label, icon, route, status?, description? }. A status shows an amber dot and a Retry sync action on the channel page.
Section chevrons are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls, and closed sections are inert so Tab skips them.

Server calls: fulfillOrder, refundOrder, capturePayment, cancelOrder, updateOrder, bulkOrders, saveProduct, saveInventory, saveDiscount, checkDiscountCode. Missing ones are simulated. Return the saved object to use it, or throw to show the message.

The sidebar follows the new Shopify admin. The store switcher, search and a notifications bell sit at the top. Orders, Products, Customers and Analytics open their sub-pages with a separate chevron, the current section opens on its own, and your open sections are remembered. Sales channels and pinned apps sit below, with an amber dot when a channel fails to sync. The footer holds one card at a time (a setup checklist first, then an announcement you can dismiss), Help & support, Settings and your account menu with theme and language. ⌘B or the rail collapses it to icons, where sections open as flyouts and counts become dots. On a phone it's a sheet that closes when you pick a page, and only the page content scrolls.
